author: datawithtristan
title: [DATA-2673] Add the User lookup page's peer inputs to mart_analytics for Sigma
body:
## What

Two tables in `mart_analytics` for the Sigma rebuild of the User lookup page:

- **`user_lookup_peer_grids`**: each user's own numbers behind the page's peer medians, zero-filled, in long format (`kind` = area, month, week):
  - area: share of active days since June 2025 that touched each product area, for every area of the product
  - month: active days per month, back from the election month on Win (0 to 12) and forward from the Serve clock on Serve (0 to 24)
  - week: outreach sends to date, back from election day on Win (0 to 26) and forward from the Serve clock on Serve (0 to 52)
- **`user_serve_clock`**: the term each Serve user's clock runs from (the term their Serve start falls in, else the latest; else the Serve start).

## Why this shape

The page compares one person with the median of a peer group picked live (same office and year, all users, power users). A peer who never touched an area, skipped a month, or had not sent yet has to count as zero in that median. Sigma has no custom SQL or cross join, so those zero rows have to exist in the warehouse. The peer group itself stays a page-side filter; nothing here depends on it.

Both are mart tables reading `user_journey` / `user_journey_events` / `user_growth_state_monthly` / `user_product_area_activity_monthly`, the same pattern as `user_journey_events` reading `user_journey`.

One intended change from the Claude dashboard: months before June 2025 (the page's Amplitude window) are left out instead of counted as zero, so they are a gap, not a drop.

## Verification (dev, 2026-10-20, stale upstream dev copies rebuilt first)

The original page queries (`person_usage`, `person_reach`) against the same medians read from the grid, peer group "same office and year":

- **Win sample person:** 57 rows, 53 exact. The 4 others are expected: one extra all-zero area row (no one used Briefings; the page hides it), and months 10 to 12 before the election have 2 to 6 fewer peers because of the June 2025 floor above.
- **Serve sample person:** 84 of 84 rows exact.
- Row counts: Win 562k area, 134k month, 1.11M week; Serve 12k area, 17k month, 87k week. `user_serve_clock`: 1,330 on a term, 590 on Serve start.
- `dbt build`: 17 of 17 tests pass.

## After merge

Sigma does not see the new tables until the `mart_analytics` schema syncs (schema row "..." menu, Sync now).

🤖 Generated with [Claude Code](https://claude.com/claude-code)

<!-- CURSOR_SUMMARY -->
---

> [!NOTE]
> **Medium Risk**
> New derived mart tables with non-trivial date/window logic for medians; wrong anchors or zero-fill rules would skew User lookup peer benchmarks, but scope is analytics-only with dbt tests and no app/auth changes.
> 
> **Overview**
> Adds two **mart_analytics** models so Sigma can rebuild the User lookup page peer medians without custom SQL or cross joins.
> 
> **`user_serve_clock`** defines one row per Serve user with `anchor_at` (elected term start when resolvable from `user_elected_office_terms`, otherwise `serve_started_at`) and `anchor_kind` (`term` vs `serve_start`), including term disambiguation when multiple terms match.
> 
> **`user_lookup_peer_grids`** materializes each user’s peer-comparison inputs in long form (`kind` = `area`, `month`, `week`) with explicit zero rows: area day-shares since June 2025 across every product area; monthly active days (Win: 0–12 months before election month; Serve: 0–24 months from the Serve clock); cumulative outreach sends/voters by week (Win: weeks before election; Serve: weeks since clock). Peer grouping stays in Sigma; **`m_analytics.yaml`** documents columns and adds uniqueness, relationships, and range tests.
> 
> <sup>Reviewed by [Cursor Bugbot](https://cursor.com/bugbot) for commit ba6ccefc0965d3c93ea73de1b5ae0a9d39bb75c8. Configure [here](https://www.cursor.com/dashboard/bugbot).</sup>
<!-- /CURSOR_SUMMARY -->

--- a/dbt/project/models/marts/analytics/m_analytics.yaml
+++ b/dbt/project/models/marts/analytics/m_analytics.yaml
@@ -3795,6 +3795,122 @@ models:
         description: Days in the month with any activity in this product.
       - name: is_partial_month
         description: The month is the current one and still filling.
+  - name: user_serve_clock
+    description: >
+      The clock each Serve user's journey is measured on, for the User lookup
+      page: their elected-office term start where known, else the day they
+      started Serve. When an official matches several terms, the one their
+      Serve start falls in wins, else the latest. One row per Serve user.
+      Internal only.
+    columns:
+      - name: user_id
+        description: gp-api user id.
+        data_tests:
+          - unique
+          - not_null
+          - relationships:
+              arguments:
+                to: ref('user_journey')
+                field: user_id
+      - name: term_start_date
+        description: Start of the chosen term; null without term dates.
+      - name: term_end_date
+        description: End of the chosen term; null when open or unknown.
+      - name: anchor_at
+        description: >
+          Day zero of the Serve clock: the term start, else the Serve start.
+      - name: anchor_kind
+        description: term or serve_start, naming where anchor_at came from.
+        data_tests:
+          - not_null
+          - accepted_values:
+              arguments:
+                values: [term, serve_start]
+  - name: user_lookup_peer_grids
+    description: >
+      Each user's own numbers behind the User lookup page's peer medians, with
+      the zeros filled in, so a peer who never touched an area, skipped a
+      month or had not sent yet still counts in the median. The peer group is
+      picked on the page; nothing here depends on it. Long format, one row per
+      user, product, kind and area or step:
+
+      area: share of the user's active days since June 2025 that touched each
+      product area (every area of the product, for every user with activity).
+      month: active days per month, counted back from the election month on
+      Win (step = months before, 0 to 12) and forward from user_serve_clock on
+      Serve (step = months since, 0 to 24), from the signup or Serve start
+      month to today; months before June 2025 are left out. week: outreach
+      sends to date per week, back from election day on Win (step = weeks
+      before, 0 to 26, counting sends up to 52 weeks out) and forward from the
+      Serve clock on Serve (step = weeks since, 0 to 52), weeks that have come
+      only.
+
+      Internal only.
+    data_tests:
+      - dbt_utils.unique_combination_of_columns:
+          arguments:
+            combination_of_columns: [user_id, product, kind, product_area, step]
+    columns:
+      - name: user_id
+        description: gp-api user id.
+        data_tests:
+          - not_null
+      - name: product
+        description: win or serve.
+        data_tests:
+          - not_null
+          - accepted_values:
+              arguments:
+                values: [win, serve]
+      - name: kind
+        description: area, month or week; picks which columns are filled.
+        data_tests:
+          - not_null
+          - accepted_values:
+              arguments:
+                values: [area, month, week]
+      - name: product_area
+        description: >
+          The product area on area rows (catalog family on Win, event-name
+          prefix on Serve); null otherwise.
+      - name: step
+        description: >
+          Months or weeks before the election (Win) or since the Serve clock
+          (Serve) on month and week rows; null on area rows.
+        data_tests:
+          - dbt_utils.accepted_range:
+              arguments:
+                min_value: 0
+                max_value: 52
+      - name: active_days
+        description: >
+          Days in the area (area rows) or active days in the month (month
+          rows).
+        data_tests:
+          - dbt_utils.accepted_range:
+              arguments:
+                min_value: 0
+      - name: product_active_days
+        description: Active days in the product since June 2025, on area rows.
+      - name: day_share
+        description: active_days / product_active_days, on area rows.
+        data_tests:
+          - dbt_utils.accepted_range:
+              arguments:
+                min_value: 0
+                max_value: 1
+      - name: sends
+        description: Outreach sends to date at the week, on week rows.
+        data_tests:
+          - dbt_utils.accepted_range:
+              arguments:
+                min_value: 0
+      - name: voters
+        description: >
+          Voters reached by those sends, on week rows. Recorded for texting
+          only.
+      - name: is_partial_month
+        description: The month is the current one and still filling, on month rows.
   - name: user_elected_office_terms
     description: >
       Term start and end for each gp-api user matched to an elected official,
diff --git a/dbt/project/models/marts/analytics/user_lookup_peer_grids.sql b/dbt/project/models/marts/analytics/user_lookup_peer_grids.sql
new file mode 100644
index 0000000..3e2e8c0
--- /dev/null
+++ b/dbt/project/models/marts/analytics/user_lookup_peer_grids.sql
@@ -0,0 +1,222 @@
+-- Per-user inputs to the User lookup page's peer medians, with the zeros filled
+-- in. A peer who never touched an area, skipped a month or had not sent by a
+-- week still counts in the median, and Sigma has no cross join to add those
+-- rows itself. The peer group is picked on the page; this table only holds
+-- each user's own numbers. Internal only.
+--
+-- kind = area: share of the user's active days that touched each product area.
+-- kind = month: active days in each month, counted back from the election
+-- month on Win (step = months before) and forward from the Serve clock on
+-- Serve (step = months since).
+-- kind = week: outreach sends to date at each week, back from election day on
+-- Win (step = weeks before, sends up to 52 weeks out) and forward from the
+-- Serve clock on Serve (step = weeks since).
+--
+-- Area and month rows cover users with product activity from June 2025, when
+-- the page's Amplitude window starts; months before it are left out, not zero.
+-- Month and week rows stop at today.
+with
+    users as (
+        select
+            u.user_id,
+            u.registered_at,
+            u.serve_started_at,
+            u.candidacy_election_date,
+            u.product in ('win', 'both') as is_win,
+            coalesce(u.is_serve_user, false) as is_serve,
+            c.anchor_at
+        from {{ ref("user_journey") }} as u
+        left join {{ ref("user_serve_clock") }} as c using (user_id)
+    ),
+
+    area_months as (
+        select *
+        from {{ ref("user_product_area_activity_monthly") }}
+        where activity_month >= date '2025-06-01'
+    ),
+
+    -- product_active_days repeats on each area row of a month; take it once.
+    product_months as (
+        select distinct user_id, product, activity_month, product_active_days
+        from area_months
+    ),
+
+    product_days as (
+        select user_id, product, sum(product_active_days) as product_active_days
+        from product_months
+        group by 1, 2
+    ),
+
+    area_days as (
+        select user_id, product, product_area, sum(area_active_days) as area_days
+        from area_months
+        group by 1, 2, 3
+    ),
+
+    areas as (select distinct product, product_area from area_days),
+
+    area_grid as (
+        select
+            p.user_id,
+            p.product,
+            'area' as kind,
+            a.product_area,
+            cast(null as int) as step,
+            coalesce(d.area_days, 0) as active_days,
+            p.product_active_days,
+            coalesce(d.area_days, 0) / p.product_active_days as day_share,
+            cast(null as bigint) as sends,
+            cast(null as bigint) as voters,
+            cast(null as boolean) as is_partial_month
+        from product_days as p
+        join areas as a using (product)
+        left join area_days as d using (user_id, product, product_area)
+    ),
+
+    month_offsets as (select explode(sequence(0, 24)) as step),
+
+    week_offsets as (select explode(sequence(0, 52)) as step),
+
+    products as (
+        select 'win' as product
+        union all
+        select 'serve'
+    ),
+
+    month_steps as (
+        select
+            p.user_id,
+            p.product,
+            s.step,
+            case
+                when p.product = 'serve'
+                then add_months(trunc(u.anchor_at, 'MM'), s.step)
+                else add_months(trunc(u.candidacy_election_date, 'MM'), - s.step)
+            end as month_start,
+            trunc(
+                case
+                    when p.product = 'serve'
+                    then u.serve_started_at
+                    else u.registered_at
+                end,
+                'MM'
+            ) as start_month
+        from product_days as p
+        join users as u using (user_id)
+        cross join month_offsets as s
+        where
+            case
+                when p.product = 'serve'
+                then u.is_serve and u.anchor_at is not null
+                else u.is_win and u.candidacy_election_date is not null and s.step <= 12
+            end
+    ),
+
+    month_grid as (
+        select
+            s.user_id,
+            s.product,
+            'month' as kind,
+            cast(null as string) as product_area,
+            s.step,
+            coalesce(
+                case
+                    when s.product = 'serve'
+                    then g.serve_activity_days
+                    else g.win_activity_days
+                end,
+                0
+            ) as active_days,
+            cast(null as bigint) as product_active_days,
+            cast(null as double) as day_share,
+            cast(null as bigint) as sends,
+            cast(null as bigint) as voters,
+            s.month_start = trunc(current_date(), 'MM') as is_partial_month
+        from month_steps as s
+        left join
+            {{ ref("user_growth_state_monthly") }} as g
+            on g.user_id = s.user_id
+            and g.activity_month = s.month_start
+        where
+            s.month_start between s.start_month and current_date()
+            and s.month_start >= date '2025-06-01'
+    ),
+
+    sends as (
+        select
+            u.user_id,
+            case when e.event = 'Serve outreach' then 'serve' else 'win' end as product,
+            coalesce(e.event_value, 0) as voters,
+            case
+                when e.event = 'Serve outreach'
+                then floor(datediff(e.event_at, u.anchor_at) / 7)
+                else floor(datediff(u.candidacy_election_date, e.event_at) / 7)
+            end as week
+        from {{ ref("user_journey_events") }} as e
+        join users as u using (user_id)
+        where e.event in ('Outreach send', 'Serve outreach')
+    ),
+
+    week_steps as (
+        select u.user_id, p.product, s.step
+        from users as u
+        cross join products as p
+        cross join week_offsets as s
+        where
+            case
+                when p.product = 'serve'
+                then
+                    u.is_serve
+                    and u.anchor_at is not null
+                    and date_add(to_date(u.anchor_at), s.step * 7) <= current_date()
+                else
+                    u.is_win
+                    and u.candidacy_election_date is not null
+                    and s.step <= 26
+                    and date_sub(u.candidacy_election_date, s.step * 7)
+                    <= current_date()
+            end
+    ),
+
+    -- Serve counts sends from the clock to the week; Win counts sends from 52
+    -- weeks out to the week before election day.
+    week_sends as (
+        select
+            s.user_id,
+            s.product,
+            s.step,
+            x.voters,
+            case
+                when s.product = 'serve'
+                then x.week between 0 and s.step
+                else x.week between s.step and 52
+            end as in_window
+        from week_steps as s
+        left join sends as x using (user_id, product)
+    ),
+
+    week_grid as (
+        select
+            x.user_id,
+            x.product,
+            'week' as kind,
+            cast(null as string) as product_area,
+            x.step,
+            cast(null as bigint) as active_days,
+            cast(null as bigint) as product_active_days,
+            cast(null as double) as day_share,
+            count_if(x.in_window) as sends,
+            coalesce(sum(case when x.in_window then x.voters end), 0) as voters,
+            cast(null as boolean) as is_partial_month
+        from week_sends as x
+        group by x.user_id, x.product, x.step
+    )
+
+select *
+from area_grid
+union all
+select *
+from month_grid
+union all
+select *
+from week_grid
diff --git a/dbt/project/models/marts/analytics/user_serve_clock.sql b/dbt/project/models/marts/analytics/user_serve_clock.sql
new file mode 100644
index 0000000..d6b2082
--- /dev/null
+++ b/dbt/project/models/marts/analytics/user_serve_clock.sql
@@ -0,0 +1,49 @@
+-- The clock each Serve user's journey is measured on, for the User lookup
+-- page: days into their elected-office term where the term is known, else
+-- days since they started Serve. One row per Serve user. Internal only.
+with
+    serve_users as (
+        select user_id, serve_started_at
+        from {{ ref("user_journey") }}
+        where coalesce(is_serve_user, false)
+    ),
+
+    -- An official can match several terms. Keep the one their Serve start
+    -- falls in, else the latest.
+    terms as (
+        select t.user_id, t.term_start_date, t.term_end_date
+        from {{ ref("user_elected_office_terms") }} as t
+        join serve_users as u using (user_id)
+        where t.term_start_date is not null
+        qualify
+            row_number() over (
+                partition by t.user_id
+                order by
+                    case
+                        when
+                            to_date(
+                                u.serve_started_at
+                            ) between t.term_start_date and coalesce(
+                                t.term_end_date, date '9999-12-31'
+                            )
+                        then 0
+                        else 1
+                    end,
+                    t.term_start_date desc,
+                    t.term_end_date desc
+            )
+            = 1
+    )
+
+select
+    u.user_id,
+    t.term_start_date,
+    t.term_end_date,
+    coalesce(
+        cast(t.term_start_date as timestamp), cast(u.serve_started_at as timestamp)
+    ) as anchor_at,
+    case
+        when t.term_start_date is not null then 'term' else 'serve_start'
+    end as anchor_kind
+from serve_users as u
+left join terms as t using (user_id)
